messages.subject: Read.Model (Extract)
parts: Is it the case that the default for read.models (which defaults to all supported sections) does not pull specific model parameters and one needs to use extract.model.parameters either separately or in conjunction with read.models?

messages.author: c83674abdeb15570
messages.subject: Re: Read.Model (Extract)
parts:
As context, I ask b/c when I specify:

My.object <- readModels('relevant directory',
                                what = "summaries", "parameters")

I get an error returned which is:

Error in list.files(path = target, recursive = recursive, full.names = TRUE) : invalid 'recursive' argument

On Thursday, May 7, 2020 at 2:02:41 AM UTC-4, J.D. Haltigan wrote:
Is it the case that the default for read.models (which defaults to all supported sections) does not pull specific model parameters and one needs to use extract.model.parameters either separately or in conjunction with read.models?

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: Read.Model (Extract)
parts:
Hi J.D.,

I think you need what=c("summaries", "parameters") so that what is a vector of things to extract. At the moment, "parameters" is being interpreted by R as the recursive argument of readModels since you're passing it as an additional argument.

Michael
